# Aqualux

> Aqualux is a specialist online shop for planted freshwater aquariums. We curate full-spectrum LED lighting, CO2 injection equipment, aquascaping tools, substrate and hardscape, and water testing kits. Products are selected on published specifications such as PAR, spectrum and physical dimensions rather than on marketing claims. Free shipping over $79, worldwide tracked delivery, and 30-day returns on unused items.

## Key facts

- Product categories: Lighting, CO2 Systems, Aquascaping Tools, Substrate & Hardscape, Water Testing.
- Lighting is the core category. Light intensity, not fertiliser, is usually the variable that decides whether a planted tank succeeds.
- Rough PAR guidance at substrate level: 20-30 PAR suits low-light plants such as Anubias, Java fern and Cryptocoryne. 50+ PAR suits carpeting plants and demanding stems, and at that level CO2 injection is effectively required.
- Running high light without matching CO2 and fertiliser is the most common cause of algae in a planted tank.
- CO2 is optional. Low-tech planted tanks work well without it. CO2 becomes worthwhile for fast growth, dense carpets, and red pigmentation in stem plants.
- We do not ship pressurised CO2 gas cylinders. They are classified as dangerous goods. We sell every other part of a CO2 system: regulator, solenoid, diffuser, bubble counter, drop checker, tubing and check valves. Cylinders are inexpensive to buy or refill locally at a welding supplier, homebrew shop or paintball store.
- A drop checker measures dissolved CO2 indirectly using a 4dKH reference solution. Blue indicates low CO2, green roughly 30 ppm, yellow too high. It lags real conditions by an hour or two, so it reads as a trend rather than a live value.
- Light bars are matched to tank length, not water volume. Where a tank falls between two sizes, size up.
- Substrate choice: active aqua soil holds nutrients and buffers pH downward, suiting rooted stem plants and shrimp. Inert sand or gravel leaves tap water parameters unchanged and suits epiphytes such as Anubias and moss attached to hardscape.

- [Water Testing](https://aqualux.store/search/testing): Liquid master test kits, test strips, and digital pH and TDS meters.
